identity.retryPolicy: Transport failures (timeout (180s), network error, HTTP 408/409/429/5xx, unreadable API response with 5xx, incomplete or missing output) are retried up to 4 attempts per turn with exponential backoff honoring Retry-After and provider reset headers. Live calls use a 5-second minimum pace, increasing automatically to stay under 80% of a reported token/minute limit, and live episodes cool down by 30 seconds; every attempt and sanitized rate-limit header is recorded. Exhausted HTTP 429 retries interrupt the batch as infrastructure rather than counting as model failure. Invalid model output (unparseable JSON, schema violation, refusal) is not retried or repaired: it is recorded as an invalid response and terminates the episode as unsolved. A valid direction that is visibly blocked is not retried or repaired: it is executed as a blocked move, counts as a wall hit, consumes the turn, and the episode continues.

aiTransport.policy: Provider requests use the shared Vercel AI SDK transport with structured output. SDK retries are disabled; Echo Maze owns every retry, pacing delay, and attempt record.

identity.coordinateSystem: Walker-relative coordinates start at (0,0). A successful move right changes x by +1, left by -1, up by +1, down by -1. A blocked move changes nothing. The Walker never receives absolute maze rows/columns.
identity.hiddenStatePolicy: The prompt receives only the narrow observation DTO (open/blocked directions, corridor sightlines, per-visible-cell open directions and isExit flag, last action/result) plus the current run's conversation. No full maze, no exit coordinates, no seed, no optimal route, no unseen cells, and no spectator state may enter the prompt.

payload.notes: Start at (0,0). Open: right, down. Exploring right path first.
At (1,0). Hallway goes right/left. Next cell at (2,0) opens down. Moving right.
At (2,0), corner turning down. Cell below at (2,-1) opens up and right. Moving down.
At (2,-1). Up leads back to (2,0). Right goes to (3,-1) which opens up and left. Moving right.
At (3,-1). Left goes back to (2,-1). Up goes to (3,0) which opens right and down. Moving up.
At (3,0). Down returns to (3,-1). Right goes to (4,0) which opens up and left. Moving right.
At (4,0). Left is (3,0). Up goes to (4,1) which opens right, down, left. Moving up.
At (4,1). Down leads back to (4,0). Left is a corridor of 4 cells ending in a dead end or turning. Right leads to (5,1) which turns down. Let's check right first.
At (5,1). Left is back to (4,1). Down leads to (5,0) which opens up and right. Moving down.
At (5,0). Up leads back to (5,1). Right sightline has 2 cells: (6,0) [right, left] and (7,0) [up, down, left]. Moving right.
At (6,0). Hallway left/right. Right at distance 1 is (7,0) which opens up, down, left. Continuing right.
At (7,0). Open: up, down, left. Up leads to (7,1) [down, left]. Down leads to (7,-1) [up, left]. Let's try up first to see where it leads.
At (7,1). Open: down, left. Left is a dead end (1 cell opening right only). So left is a dead end! Moving down back to (7,0).
Back at (7,0). (7,1) branch was a dead end. Down leads to (7,-1) [up, left]. Let's explore down.
At (7,-1). Up goes back to (7,0). Left goes to (6,-1) which opens right and down. Let's move left.
At (6,-1). Right is (7,-1). Down goes to (6,-2) which opens up and right. Moving down.
At (6,-2). Up goes back to (6,-1). Right goes to (7,-2) which opens down and left. Moving right.
At (7,-2). Down leads down a corridor 4 cells long ending at (7,-6) turning left. Left goes back to (6,-2). Moving down.
At (7,-3). Moving down hallway towards (7,-6). Cells down: (7,-4), (7,-5), (7,-6) which turns left.
At (7,-4). Hallway continues down 2 more cells to (7,-6) which opens up and left. Moving down.
At (7,-5). Hallway continues down 1 more cell to (7,-6) which opens up and left. Moving down.
At (7,-6). Corner turning left. Up leads back down the long corridor. Left goes to (6,-6) which opens right and down. Moving left.
At (6,-6). Exit visible down at distance 1 ((6,-7))! Moving down to exit.
